339-677-7060-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-7060-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
1115-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-6495-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1349-6012-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-6012-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Reluctant Role Model.
When Reluctant Role Model dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Reluctant Role Model from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 6.
Repeat.
1349-6012-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2034-4871-6201-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

877-2292-3081-3817.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2092-4866-7426-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2092-4866-7426-7737.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1257-1362-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1257-1362-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1394-2060-5256-7038-7315.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by High Score.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by High Score.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-4460.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

678-5670-7173.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-5670-7173.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

323-5170-6132-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3963-6995-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3963-6995-7009.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-6995-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2167-2653-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2167-2653-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Holding priority, activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing the Mutavault token, adding {C}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2-4659-5554-6291.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Gnome and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

719-3767-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
719-3767-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1580-2034-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat

4681-4894-5231-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

2593-4067-6002.notablePrerequisites: Astral Cornucopia has at least six charge counters on it.
2593-4067-6002.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vineweft, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Activate Vineweft by paying {4}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1430-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Image on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Mirror Image do not have summoning sickness.
1430-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Mirror Image.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Mirror Image.
Activate Mirror Image by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mirror Image ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

1170-1418-1645-5478-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-2187-2417.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Possessed Skaab exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-2187-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2015-3783-4300.description:
Activate Phyrexian Tower's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing an Illusion, adding {B}{B}.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Phyrexian Tower from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Phyrexian Tower from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2061-2104-2556.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-2556.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3240-4050-5687.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1116-3025-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3025-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1447-2511-2719.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

277-3430-4499-5954.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1006-2178-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1006-2178-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

803-1641-1812-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2397-4813-5003-5256.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
2397-4813-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Famished Foragers' power.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

1737-2092-2119-2544.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
1737-2092-2119-2544.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Seat of the Synod.
Activate the Seat of the Synod token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1086-1722-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1086-1722-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2825-3263-3525-4739.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three creatures.
2825-3263-3525-4739.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Battle Hymn without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Battle Hymn, adding at least {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you control four or more creatures, this combo nets infinite mana.

396-678-2034-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
396-678-2034-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Realm-Scorcher Hellkite trigger, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

4-3258-4428.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows either from your hand or from exile by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Hoarding Broodlord.
When Hoarding Broodlord enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.

2758-3525-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Grimoire Thief.
Grimoire Thief does not have summoning sickness.
2758-3525-4289.description:
Activate Grimoire Thief by tapping it, adding {U}.
Grimoire Thief triggers, exiling the top three cards of an opponent's library face down.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Grimoire Thief.
Repeat.

1442-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ishkanah, adding {C}{C}.
When Ishkanah dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ishkanah from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ishkanah enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4629-5017-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have the highest life total.
4629-5017-5115.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Urban Daggertooth and a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

726-4944.description:
Activate Dark Maze's ability.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

998-1080-1494-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands.
At least four +1/+1 counters on Scute Mob.
998-1080-1494-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by tapping it and paying {2}, casting a copy of Bioshift without paying its mana cost, targeting Scute Mob and Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Bioshift copy, moving four +1/+1 counters from Scute Mob onto Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, generating an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your extra turn's upkeep, Scute Mob triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.
